title: 102m dorje
name: Dorje Chang guru yoga, advanced retreat
summary: A guided Dorje Chang guru yoga: settle posture and breath, generate bodhicitta, invoke an inner refuge of masters who merge into Dorje Chang, then receive white light from the forehead, red light from the throat, and blue light from the heart to purify body, speech, and mind before his form dissolves into light and descends into your heart as inseparable from your own awareness. Reach for it when you want a devotional, visually rich reset that roots your practice in a felt sense of already-complete trust and refuge.

title: 103m c1-3 vigilance
name: Elephant path, stages 1-3: vigilance
summary: Nine rounds of breath to purify the channels, a bodhicitta aspiration and blending with the lineage masters, then progressive concentration on the base of the body, the lower half, and finally the whole body as it breathes, sharpened throughout by the rope of mindfulness, the hook of alert vigilance, and rising curiosity until attention flows like a continuous river. Reach for it when your focus is scattered across many small pulls and you need a structured, escalating anchor to gather it into one steady field.

title: 105m c4-5 balancing energy
name: Elephant path, stages 4-5: balancing energy
summary: Nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing and a lineage-blessing visualization settle the mind before resting into the whole body as one field of feeling, then white-lotus or black-lotus light corrects dullness or agitation into balanced energy, and finally attention sharpens into the body's edges until they dissolve into a vibrating, boundaryless field. Reach for it when you're settled enough to sit still but foggy or restless underneath, and you want to move from body awareness into subtler energetic sensation.

title: 106m c6-7 enjoying the body, effortless
name: Elephant path, stages 6-7: enjoying the body
summary: Guided progression through Stages 5-7 of the Elephant Path: settle into whole-body breath awareness, sharpen curiosity at the skin's edges until the body dissolves into vibrating energy, then repeatedly ease the rope of mindfulness to taste effortlessness, using a brief tightening if attention scatters. Reach for it when your focus has already stabilized and you are ready to loosen your grip without losing the thread.

title: 108m c1-9 vast ocean
name: Elephant path, stage 9: the vast ocean
summary: Guided progression through the final stages of shamatha—settling into whole-body breath awareness, easing effort until it becomes stable and effortless, making fine-tuned adjustments between tightening and loosening until the object grows vivid and the mind clear, then locking onto the deepest channel of energy amid the vibrancy, like finding the Milky Way among countless stars, to arrive at one-pointed, laser-like focus. Reach for it when your concentration practice already has a foundation and you are ready to refine a stable, alert focus into something sharper and more unwavering.

title: 110m awareness emptiness from tashi namgyal
name: Awareness-emptiness, after Tashi Namgyal
summary: After clearing breaths and a brief guru-yoga blessing, this practice searches for a solid self in the body, in thoughts, and in emotions, then searches for the searcher and finally examines awareness itself for shape, color, or substance, closing with Tashi Namgyal's pointing-out instructions asking whether it is an entity, whether it is empty like nothingness or like space, and whether its knowing quality is radiant like light. Reach for it when you want to move past simply concentrating and actually confirm, through direct looking, that the self and the awareness observing it are empty yet vividly aware.

title: 112m boundless, same taste
name: Boundless, then same taste
summary: Guru yoga and refuge lead into a body scan that dissolves the edges of the body in all directions until awareness feels boundless, then this open awareness is applied to every arising sight, sound, and thought as one taste, closing with Tashi Namyok's pointing-out instructions on thoughts as indivisible from awareness. Reach for it when you feel boxed into a small sense of self and want to verify, directly, that everything arising is workable because it's made of the same stuff as the space that holds it.

title: 114m effortless one taste, singing
name: Effortless one taste
summary: This session moves through three levels of one taste: first affirming awareness as the changeless basis while relative content arises within it like breezes in the sky, then extending to all-pervasive non-duality where space, objects, and knowing merge into a single saturating field, then sealing each arising thought, sound, and sensation with increasing speed until recognition becomes effortless, closing with a group doha song to celebrate the realization. Reach for it when you want to move past a settled but static awareness into a felt sense of everything as one seamless, self-recognizing taste.

title: 202m ⭐️ crossing over
name: Crossing over
summary: This session moves through nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing, an invocation of masters whose blessings dissolve into the heart, a search for the self that finds only awareness, an opening into boundless non-dual awareness with eyes closed then open, and a sealing practice that recognizes every thought, sound, and sensation as the same taste until effort dissolves into non-meditation. Reach for it when you have already stabilized awareness in shorter sits and are ready to push toward full non-dual recognition and its collapse into effortlessness.

title: 205m lion's gaze, child in a temple stunned
name: Lion's gaze, the child in the temple
summary: Clearing breaths and a blending-light guru yoga settle the body and mind, then a search for the self gives way to resting as open, all-pervasive awareness, one taste practiced first with thoughts and senses, then sealed in immediacy and range until effortlessness stabilizes and Tilopa's six nails release even the residue of recalling, anticipating, thinking, examining, and controlling. Reach for it when you have real time to go deep and want a complete arc from ordinary awareness through non-dual recognition into effortless, self-liberating rest.

title: 207m condensed instructions 5qs
name: Five questions for the natural state
summary: A brief pre-meditation routine of body check, posture, three clearing breaths, and calling in support settles the mind before five condensed questions—boundless, non-dual, effortless, lucid, centerless—are each asked and directly checked against experience, with any missing quality restored simply by intending it. Reach for it when you already know the taste of awakened awareness and want a fast, minimal-instruction way back into it rather than a long setup.

title: 210m 16 lines for aa
name: Sixteen lines for awakened awareness
summary: Opens with clearing breaths and eyes-open settling, invites the lineage masters and Dorje Chan to dissolve into light at the heart, then walks through Lama Shabkar's sixteen lines pointing directly to awareness as birthless, self-clearing, and unmodified, deepening into non-doing instructions to rest without basis until thoughts are recognized as the luminosity of the still sea itself. Reach for it when you already sense awakened awareness present and want condensed pointing-out instructions to stabilize and deepen it, rather than a technique to get there.

title: 213m 5 lines, clarifying the natural state
name: Five lines from Clarifying the Natural State
summary: Opens with a devotional preliminary of light and blessings dissolving into the heart, then guides awareness through Tashi Namgyal's five analogies in order: wide open like the sky, all-pervasive like the earth, unshakable like a mountain, shining like a flame, and lucid like a crystal. Reach for it when you want a complete, condensed pointer to the natural state without wading through commentary.

title: 303m immediacy
name: Immediacy: getting back in the view
summary: Nine rounds of breath to settle body and mind, then a guru-yoga-style invocation of blessings and a "meditation master" self-view to build trust, followed by condensed pointing-out instructions checking awareness for openness, all-pervasiveness, effortlessness, lucidity, and centerlessness, and finally practice re-triggering that recognition through the sharp PUT shout or a forceful nasal exhale whenever it clouds over. Reach for it when you are freshly awake and alert but want to establish and repeatedly re-catch open awareness before the day's activity fragments it.

title: 305m favorite clouds
name: Your favourite clouds
summary: Three clearing breaths and an invocation of masters settle the mind into awakened awareness, then each time the view clouds over you identify which favorite cloud caused it—self, perception, duality, effort, thought, or localization—before using immediacy to rest back into the view. Reach for it when you keep touching a clear, open awareness only to lose it again and again, and need to learn your own recurring pattern of distraction so you can catch it faster each time.

title: 307m radiance of thought, differentiation from emptiness
name: Radiance of thought
summary: Analyzes thought first as empty—checking where it arises, stays, and vanishes, and whether it has size, shape, or color—then opens awakened awareness through spaciousness, pervasiveness, and effortlessness, and finally re-views thought as radiance: quick, luminous streaks of light that no longer obscure but enhance the view. Reach for it when thoughts feel like clouds or distractions and you want them to become companions in the practice rather than obstacles to it.

title: 309m ⭐️ radiance of emotions
name: Radiance of emotions
summary: Guided invocation and settling followed by an emptiness-of-emotion pass that strips a strong feeling down to raw energy and searches for the self experiencing it until both dissolve into open awareness, then a return to that same emotion so it can be re-felt as radiant patterns of light and energy arising from awakened awareness itself. Reach for it when you feel emotionally flat or numb first thing in the morning and want your capacity to feel restored without getting hijacked by the story behind it.

title: 311m ⭐️ radiance of self
name: Radiance of self
summary: Guided search for the self through body, thoughts, and emotions until it is found unfindable, then affirms the awareness that remains as empty yet knowing, before opening that empty awareness into radiance so the relative self can shine as a vivid, expressive vehicle rather than something to erase. Reach for it when you feel flattened or numb from emptiness practice and need to reconnect with a vivid, personal, embodied sense of self.

title: 313m radiance of perception
name: Radiance of perception
summary: Opens with a light-transmission blessing from the assembled masters, then cycles through each sense gate viewing sounds, sights, sensations, smells, and tastes as insubstantial yet occurring like echoes, mirages, and dreams, before shifting into Awakened Awareness itself and reviewing those same perceptions as its radiant display, like stars and planets reflected on a still lake. Reach for it when perception feels solid or distracting and you want sensory experience itself to become the reminder of awareness rather than a distraction from it.

title: 402m radiance of everything
name: Radiance of everything
summary: This practice moves through a lineage refuge and light-blessing visualization into condensed instructions for awakened awareness (open, formless, all-pervasive, sourceless), then extends that recognition outward so every sight, sound, sensation, and thought is experienced as the radiance of that same awareness, stabilizing the view into one continuous taste across meditation and daily activity. Reach for it when your formal recognition of awareness feels solid but keeps getting interrupted by ordinary perception, and you need each moment of the day to reinforce rather than obscure the view.

title: 405m one taste standing, walking, lying down
name: One taste standing, walking, lying down
summary: Opens with a field-of-support invocation and settling into awakened awareness through its knowing and centerless aspects, then carries that radiance through sitting, standing, walking, and lying down while deliberately watching the transitions between each posture for gaps in continuity. Reach for it when your formal sitting practice feels solid but dissolves the moment you get up and move.

title: 409m mixing - body speech mind positive neutral negative
name: Mixing with body, speech and mind
summary: This session establishes awakened awareness as the ground view, then deliberately tests it across nine domains—positive, neutral, and negative activity of body (bowing, walking, striking a cushion), speech (blessing, small talk, trash talk), and mind—checking after each whether the view held continuously, was lost and recovered, or collapsed entirely. Reach for it when you want a diagnostic of exactly where your practice breaks down rather than a state of calm itself.

title: 412m mixing - radiance of perception
name: Mixing with what you see and hear
summary: Sets the view through a short preliminary sequence—clearing breath, intention, calling forth the assembly, dissolving them into light at the heart—then sends you off the cushion for ten minutes to walk through ordinary life treating every sight, sound, and sensation as the radiance of awareness itself, tracking immediacy, frequency, and duration and noting exactly what knocks you out of the view. Reach for it when you are ready to leave the cushion and want to catch, in real time, what clouds awakened awareness during ordinary perception.

title: 414m mixing - radiance of thoughts and emotions
name: Mixing with thoughts and emotions
summary: This session opens with breath and a masters-blessing invocation to establish the ground, re-enters the view through intention or fallback methods like Pat and checking sky-like, earth-like, and flame-like qualities, then shifts emphasis to thoughts, emotions, and the sense of self as radiance itself before taking that recognition off the cushion into daily activity. Reach for it when you keep treating your own thoughts and emotions as obstacles to clear away rather than as the very shine of awareness you're trying to notice.

title: 501m recap
name: Recap: ground, sealing, radiance
summary: Settles posture and motivation, invokes the guru as light dissolving into the heart to merge minds, opens awareness in all directions until it feels boundless like the sky and pervasive like the earth, then seals sounds, sensations, thoughts, and even hopes and fears as the same taste before resting in centerless, effortless knowing and finally viewing all appearances as the radiance of that awareness. Reach for it when you already have some ground in awareness practice and want a full run-through of stabilizing it, from ground to view to seeing all experience as its display.

title: 504m mixing with difficult circumstances
name: Six ways of using difficulty
summary: Opens with the pointing-out instructions and guru-blessing visualization to establish awakened awareness, then applies that same view of radiance through six escalating difficult circumstances in turn: complex thought, intense emotion, benevolent or terrifying people, suffering, and sickness. Reach for it when a specific difficulty is already active and you want to workshop it into the path rather than escape it.

title: 507m deepening enhancement practice
name: Enhancement: stillness, luminosity, bliss
summary: Establishes the view of awakened awareness through posture, invoking the assembly of masters, and settling methods, then deliberately evokes stillness, luminosity, and bliss one by one and reframes each as mere radiance of that awareness before playing a chant to intensify the special states without letting attention snag on them. Reach for it when special states like bliss or vivid clarity have arisen and threaten to distract you from the deeper recognition they are meant to enhance.

title: 510m effortlessness
name: Effortlessness
summary: This practice invites the assembly of masters for blessings that dissolve into light and merge with your heart, establishes the view of awakened awareness as centerless and knowing, then progressively strips away all effort—abandoning the meditator, the urge to check, and the impulse to correct wandering thoughts—until awareness sustains itself like a continuous river. Reach for it when your practice already feels stable and you are ready to drop the last subtle effort of maintaining it.

title: 603m ⭐️ info processing
name: How a thought gets built
summary: Guides eyes-open awareness through a chosen object's full information-processing arc—contact, engagement, hedonic tone, categorization, conceptualization, self-referential meaning—then reverses course, stripping each layer away until the object dissolves back into the open field, from which lion's gaze awareness recognizes itself and finally re-engages the object as pure radiance without accepting or rejecting anything. Reach for it when you are intellectually restless and want to understand the mechanics of perception itself, not just settle the mind.

title: 606m ⭐️ tracelessness intro
name: Tracelessness
summary: Guides you through the familiar setup of posture, intention, and invoking the assembly of masters into a heart-blend, then re-establishes awakened awareness and its radiance before introducing the subtle shift of tracelessness, watching things arise as radiance and vanish without a trace against the stainless ground, like riding on water. Reach for it when your awareness is already stable and radiant on and off the cushion, and you are ready to stop tracking how things arise and start noticing how completely they disappear.

title: 609m ⭐️ review of path to tracelessness
name: The whole path, ending in tracelessness
summary: Nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing, an inner-refuge visualization of light from the assembly of masters dissolving into the heart, then a full run through recognizing awakened awareness, sealing with immediacy and range, resting in effortless emptiness, and orienting to the totality of awareness as the ground and appearing aspects of awakening. Reach for it when you already know awakened awareness but need the full staged path to re-find and stabilize it rather than a quick pointer.

title: 2 Counting Within the Breath (Guided Meditation) - (Practising the Jhānas) [BzI0olLseZI]
name: Counting within the breath
summary: Establish whole-body awareness, then find the longest comfortable breath and count within it up to nine on the in-breath and back down to one on the out-breath, layering in the visual sense of bright numbers and the inner sound of counting them, before shortening the breath and count to six and then three, always returning to whole-body sensitivity. Reach for it when your energy is low, even if the mind feels scattered, and you need a structured practice with more pegs to gather scattered attention.

title: 3 The Energy Body and the Whole-body breath (Instructions and Guided Meditation) - (Practising the... [1iNaS0tNcJM]
name: The energy body
summary: Settles the posture into a balance of alertness and softness, then opens attention to the whole-body space beyond the physical outline, sensing its texture and vibration rather than surface contact, and finally lets the breath be noticed for how it moves and changes that whole felt space. Reach for it when your attention feels scattered across separate body parts and you want it to gather into one unified field before working with the breath.

title: C(St.9) + Radiance(Weggis23) - 40min
name: Stage 9 concentration into radiance
summary: Seven-point posture and three clearing breaths, then a guru-yoga style invocation and dissolution of masters into light at the heart, followed by a brief search for the self's location before settling attention at the base of the body and progressively widening it to the whole body through the nine stages of shamatha, using white and black lotus visualizations to balance dullness and agitation, then fine-tuning tightness and looseness until the body dissolves into a field of vibrant energy and a deeper channel is found within it. Reach for it when you have time for a full formal sit and want a complete arc from devotion and view into deep absorption, not just a quick settling technique.

title: Gampopas Instructions - 30min(Weggis23)
name: Gampopa's instructions
summary: This session moves through clearing breaths and posture, sets intention while calling forth a field of masters whose blessings dissolve into a sphere of light at the heart, searches for and fails to find a self, then opens awareness through hearing, sight, and all arising phenomena as waves or breezes within a boundless ocean-sky, before sealing each event as empty with increasing speed until effort dissolves into soft, self-contented, uninterrupted resting. Reach for it when you want a full guided arc from devotion and self-inquiry into open awareness practice, rather than a quick technique.

title: Radiance(Jan24) - 30min
name: Radiance, thirty minutes
summary: This session moves through posture and clearing breaths, invokes a lineage of masters to bless and merge with the mind, then searches for a findable self in the body and in thoughts until it dissolves, opens into sky-like awareness where all sound, sight, and thought are one taste, and finishes by sealing each arising instantly as empty until effort itself falls away. Reach for it when you want a full arc from settling the body to resting in effortless non-dual awareness, and have thirty unhurried minutes to let it build.

title: Sealing - 20min(Jan24)
name: Sealing, twenty minutes
summary: This 20-minute practice moves through posture and clearing breaths, sets an intention and calls forth a field of support that dissolves into light at the heart, searches for a self in the body, thoughts, and emotions to find it unfindable, rests in wide-open awareness likened to the sky with all experience as its breeze, then quickens into moment-by-moment sealing of each thought, sound, and sensation as empty until effortlessness breaks through. Reach for it when you want a complete run from grounded posture through non-dual view to rapid-fire liberation of whatever arises, rather than just a quick settling in.

title: Shavari's Instructions - 25min(Weggis23)
name: Shavari's instructions
summary: This 25-minute Mahamudra practice opens with posture, clearing breaths, and lineage-blessing visualization, then searches for and dissolves the sense of self, opens awareness to sound and sight as a boundless sky or ocean with phenomena as inseparable waves, accelerates recognition of each arising thought or sensation as empty appearance, seals every obstacle and hope or fear as itself empty, and finally locates and dissolves the center of awareness to rest in centerless, formless knowing. Reach for it when you want a full guided arc from settled body into nondual, centerless awareness rather than a quick reset.

title: Timeless Awareness(Breath) - 10min(Ru23)
name: Timeless awareness, breath and sound
summary: This 10-minute practice opens with intention-setting and a guru-yoga style blessing that dissolves into light at the heart, then uses the breath's coming and going to point at the awareness that knows it, and finally shifts to the wide-open field of hearing to locate that same timeless, changeless awareness underlying all sounds. Reach for it when your mind feels tangled in time and urgency and you need to drop into the awareness that was never rushing in the first place.

title: Timeless-Boundless Awareness(Body) - 15min(Stages23)
name: Timeless and boundless through the body
summary: Guru-yoga refuge and a search for the meditator dissolve into resting as whole-body felt sense, then that awareness is expanded skinless in all directions until it forms a boundless sphere, at which point sounds are recognized as arising within it, inseparable, one taste of awareness-emptiness. Reach for it when you feel contracted into a small, solid sense of self and want to verify boundlessness directly rather than just be told about it.

title: Timeless-Boundless Awareness(Sound) - 10min(Weggis23)
name: Timeless and boundless through sound
summary: Opens with guru-yoga blessings and a search for the self that dissolves into bare awareness, then shifts to the field of hearing, using sound as proof that awareness is wide open and then searching the edges of that field until they dissolve into timeless, boundless space. Reach for it when you feel hemmed in or contracted and need sound itself to prove there is more room than you think.

title: ⭐️ 603m info processing_modified
name: Info processing
summary: Guides a single object from bare contact through hedonic tone, categorization, conceptual meaning, and self-referential memory into full consciousness of it, then reverses the sequence back to bare awareness before widening into a field-wide Lion's Gaze and finally letting the object reappear as the radiance of awareness itself. Reach for it when your mind is intellectually restless and over-analyzing experience, and you need to see the machinery of perception itself dissolve back into open awareness.

title: care to give
name: Care to give
summary: A repeated contemplative question shifts in stages, from "What would it feel like to be love?" to "to have a lot of care to give" to "to be loved," allowing a raw inner voice to surface its self-blame before the mind is anchored on the single verse Ecclesiastes 5:11 as a resting point. Reach for it when you wake up already rehearsing guilt and grasping for more than you have.

title: 103m dorje chang
name: Dorje Chang guru yoga
summary: This guru yoga establishes body, speech, and mind, sets a bodhicitta intention, invites an assembly of masters who dissolve into Dorje Chang, then receives white, red, and blue light from his forehead, throat, and heart to purify body, speech, and mind before he dissolves into light and merges inseparably with your own awareness. Reach for it when you want to open a retreat or practice session by grounding into devotion and trust rather than starting cold.

title: 104m conc 1-2 settling mind, rope, hook, flames
name: Elephant path, stages 1-2: settling the mind
summary: Sets posture and intention, then anchors attention to the base of the body with the rope of mindfulness and hook of knowing, before sharpening curiosity into the felt boundary where the seat meets the chair until it softens and focus holds continuously. Reach for it when the mind is scattered like a waterfall and you need to find the first foothold of steady attention.

title: 106m conc 2 whole body
name: Elephant path, stage 2: the whole body
summary: Guided setup with clearing breaths and a blessing-light visualization, then mindfulness anchored at the seat, expanding in stages through the lower body, midsection, and upper body until the whole body is held as one field of breathing awareness. Reach for it when your attention is scattered across parts of yourself and you need a stepwise on-ramp into a single, unified sense of presence.

title: 108m conc complete continuous
name: Elephant path, stage 2: complete and continuous
summary: Opens with posture, clearing breaths, and a refuge visualization of blessing light purifying body, speech, and mind, then settles attention at the base of the body and expands it in stages—lower half, midsection, then the whole body—resting as one field of feeling and eventually tracking the breath's subtle expansion and release. Reach for it when your mind is scattered and overstimulated and you need a slow, structured build from a single point into full-body, continuous focus.

title: 111m conc 1-5
name: Elephant path, stages 1-5
summary: Nine rounds of nine-cycle breath purification through the channels, followed by inviting an assembly of masters (with optional focus on Dorje Chong) who dissolve into light and merge with the heart, then settles into whole-body awareness, checks and balances energy with the white and black lotus visualizations, and finishes by dissolving the body's felt boundaries into a field of vibrant energy. Reach for it when you feel scattered or heavy-bodied in the morning and need a structured path from purification through settling into a subtle, spacious sense of the body.

title: 113m 6-7 loosening
name: Elephant path, stages 6-7: loosening
summary: Opens with a teaching on the nine stages of concentration and the taming/pacifying phase where effort eases toward effortlessness, then leads nine rounds of breath visualized as spheres of light purifying attachment, aversion, and ignorance through the right, left, and central channels. Reach for it when your practice has grown mechanical and you want to loosen your grip on effort while still keeping the mind on track.

title: 116m 8-9
name: Elephant path, stages 8-9
summary: Reviews the final stages of the nine-stage path, then leads three clearing breaths with light visualization, a request for blessings from an assembled field of masters dissolved into one sphere of light at the heart, and a settling of mind into body and body into the base of contact before opening into fine-tuned effortlessness, optimal clarity, and the deepest channel. Reach for it when your concentration is already fairly stable and you want to refine it into full one-pointed absorption.

title: 203m ⭐️ equanimity (starts 2m)
name: Equanimity, the first immeasurable
summary: Three clearing breaths and a field of masters dissolving into light at the heart open into a body scan, then a difficult person is brought to mind to catch reactivity and mental elaboration as they arise in real time, before the same person is imagined acting warmly so you can watch the mind construct new, equally biased positive categories just as fast. Reach for it when you notice you've fixed someone into a permanent story of annoyance and want to catch judgment constructing itself before it hardens.

title: 205m awareness perspective (vs event)
name: Awareness rather than the event
summary: A hands-on-knees then breath exercise for toggling emphasis between the event (sensations, the breath moving) and the awareness observing it, switching back and forth several times before stabilizing curiosity on the field of awareness itself. Reach for it when you're stuck inside the content of experience and need to practice standing back as the knowing that holds it.

title: 207m ⭐️ empty self tour (starts 6m)
name: A tour of the empty self
summary: Three clearing breaths with light visualization to sharpen the mind, then a bodhicitta intention and blessing from a field of masters dissolved into the heart, followed by systematically evoking a sense of self through traits and preferences and then searching for it first outside the body and then through the chest, head, and eyes to find it unfindable while awareness itself remains. Reach for it when you feel solidly identified with a self made of preferences and traits and want direct experiential evidence that it cannot be located anywhere.

title: 209m 8 worldly concerns (+7m)
name: The eight worldly concerns
summary: Purifying breaths, refuge, and blessing-light lead into a guided recall of the eight worldly concerns—starting with gain and loss—where you vividly summon a personal memory of each, feel how the self grasps or recoils, and then rest in awareness beyond that reactivity. Reach for it when you keep chasing certain outcomes or bracing against others and want to see the grasping self clearly enough to stop mistaking it for you.

title: 212m i2 uncond love
name: Unconditional love, the second immeasurable
summary: Three-breath purification and calling of the assembly to take inner refuge, then recalling a specific person who showed you genuine kindness, feeling how their care shaped you, and extending that same unconditional love outward to others without expecting anything back. Reach for it when you feel walled off or self-protective and need to remember what it feels like to be loved freely before you can offer it to anyone else.

title: 214m empty perceptions (+7m)
name: Empty perceptions
summary: Opens with three clearing breaths and a refuge visualization of masters dissolving into light at the heart, then builds body awareness section by section until the whole body feels porous and edgeless, finally opening the space below and in front of the body into wide open awareness. Reach for it when you want the day's first perceptions to feel dreamlike and insubstantial rather than solid and urgent.

title: 301m empty thoughts
name: Empty thoughts
summary: Opens with a lineage-blessing and self-inquiry into the meditator and mind before turning to thought itself, first searching for its location inside or outside the body, then tracking where each thought comes from and where it vanishes to. Reach for it when thoughts feel solid and grabby and you need direct evidence, not just belief, that they are empty.

title: 303m empty emotions (+10m)
name: Empty emotions
summary: Clearing breaths and a field-of-support visualization lead into choosing a familiar emotion, evoking it through an imagined scene, feeling its somatic charge in the body, searching for both the emotion and the self who feels it until neither can be found, then returning to the raw sensation from that open space so it matures into its clearest, most skillful expression. Reach for it when you are gripped by a strong feeling, positive or negative, and want to feel it fully rather than suppress or indulge it.

title: 306m imm compassion
name: Compassion, the third immeasurable
summary: Nine rounds of channel breathing to settle the body, then an opening into wide-field hearing where sounds, sensations, thoughts, and the body itself are met as insubstantial, dreamlike arisings, followed by tonglen on a diamond at the heart that inhales this week's difficulties as dark smoke and exhales them back as healing compassionate light. Reach for it when your suffering or someone else's feels too solid and close, and you need distance without becoming cold to it.

title: 308m imperm death
name: Impermanence and dying
summary: After clearing breaths and a blessing visualization, the practice moves through the seasons of a landscape and then the seasons of your own life from childhood to old age, before guiding you through a deathbed sequence where earth, water, fire, air, and space dissolve in turn until only vast, timeless awareness remains. Reach for it when you want to metabolize a low hum of death-anxiety into presence and appreciation for the life you are actually living.

title: 310m timeliness boundless awareness
name: Timeliness boundless awareness
summary: This meditation opens with three clearing breaths and refuge, then searches for a self in the body, thoughts, emotions, and the meditator itself until only knowing awareness remains, before resting attention into the seat and body and opening into the field of hearing to discover it has no findable edge or boundary in any direction. Reach for it when you feel boxed in or contracted and need direct evidence that awareness itself is boundless.

title: 312m body boundless awareness
name: Body boundless awareness
summary: A brief refuge and lineage invocation grounds you in the seat and body as one field of feeling, then that field is opened direction by direction—down, front, up, back, sides, and intermediates—until the body's edges dissolve into a boundless, timeless awareness that remains unimpacted by whatever arises within it. Reach for it when you feel confined by your body or racing thoughts about time and need to root into something vast and unchanging.

title: 402m imm4 compersion
name: Empathetic joy, the fourth immeasurable
summary: Teaches empathetic joy through three clearing breaths, an invocation of masters dissolving into light at the heart, then bringing a close person to mind and imagining them surpassing you in success, happiness, and impact until any comparison dissolves and their joy is felt as your own. Reach for it when someone else's good fortune is triggering envy or jealousy instead of gladness.

title: 406m same taste awareness + events
name: Same taste, awareness and events
summary: Begins with three clearing breaths and a masters-blending visualization into the heart, then a brief search for the self through body and thoughts to find it unfindable, then opens awareness through hearing in 360 degrees before opening the eyes so that sights, sounds, sensations, and thoughts are all recognized as arising within and as that same open awareness, like a sky viewing its own breeze. Reach for it when you want to stop treating thoughts, sensations, and perceptions as separate from awareness itself and taste their underlying sameness.

title: 408m generosity same taste gift giver
name: Generosity, the first perfection
summary: Opens with clearing breaths, an intention, and a field-of-support visualization, then settles awareness into a wide-open sky-like field with no edges before recalling a time you received generosity and a time you gave it, reviewing the day for missed chances to be generous, and resting in the sense that giver, gift, and receiver are all one taste. Reach for it when you want your generosity to feel spontaneous and unforced rather than effortful or transactional.

title: 410m saturates, immediacy, nondual
name: All-pervasiveness and sealing
summary: Opens with clearing breaths, a request for blessings, and a search for the self that dissolves into bare awareness, then mixes that awareness with outer space through the eyes until inside and outside merge, appearances are recognized as the same taste as awareness, the whole field is confirmed as one non-dual saturation with no edges, and finally each arising thought is quickly sealed as that same taste. Reach for it when your looking already feels open and spacious but slightly slow or effortful, and you want to sharpen it into an immediate, self-recognizing non-dual awareness.

title: 413m sealing w reactivity
name: Sealing a reaction before it lands
summary: This session opens with clearing breaths and a blessing visualization, moves through an emptiness-of-self and no-findable-meditator inquiry into open awareness, establishes non-duality by merging the sense fields into one seamless field, then trains rapid sealing of each arising thought, sound, or sensation as empty the instant it appears, and finally applies that sealing to recalled afflictive emotions and reactive episodes so they are either calmed on arising or freed into their energy. Reach for it when you keep getting swept into reactive emotional patterns and want to catch and release them at the root before they turn into conduct you regret.

title: 502m sealing range, effortless
name: Sealing the whole range
summary: This Mahamudra practice moves through nine-round breathing to clear stale air, invokes a field of masters (or Dorje Chan) whose blessings dissolve into the heart, opens the eyes to merge awareness with space until no boundary remains between knower and known, then seals each arising event as the same taste of emptiness with increasing immediacy and comprehensiveness until effort itself falls away. Reach for it when you are practicing well but sense a residue of subtle effort or striving that keeps genuine ease out of reach.

title: 505m ⭐️ patience (+7m)
name: Patience, the third perfection
summary: Opens with teaching on patience as the third perfection—its three forms and their near and far enemies—then moves into practice: three clearing breaths, invoking a support field and dissolving it into the heart, searching body, thoughts, emotions, and the meditator itself for a findable self, then resting as boundless timeless awareness in which all sensory events arise as one taste, finally dissolving the inside/outside boundary through the visual field. Reach for it when you want to root patience and compassion in a direct experience of selflessness rather than just an intention to be more patient.

title: 508m ⭐️ diligence
name: Diligence, the fourth perfection
summary: Nine-breath purification and a guru-yoga refuge visualization open into resting as open awareness where all experience is one taste, then this ground is used to examine procrastination and absorption in trivial activities, applying the contemplation of death and the preciousness of this life as antidotes to each. Reach for it when you keep putting off what matters most and want death and rarity of opportunity to burn away your excuses.

title: 510m ⭐️ 6 nails, 6p concentration, king of samadhi
name: Six nails into king of samadhi
summary: This practice moves through nine clearing breaths with light visualization, a bodhicitta intention and blessing shower from a field of support, a brief emptiness-of-self inquiry, then opens hearing and seeing into wide, boundless, non-dual awareness before sealing each arising thought, sound, or sensation in immediate recognition of one taste, and finally dissolves hope, fear, and other subtle beliefs that block effortless rest. Reach for it when you are already familiar with non-dual awareness but notice subtle grasping, hope, or fear still keeping you from total effortless rest.

title: 603m centerless
name: Centerless awareness
summary: Three clearing breaths and a blessing-light visualization settle body and mind, then an emptiness-of-self inquiry opens into sky-like awareness that recognizes sound, sight, and all arising events as one taste, sealing first with immediacy and then with effortlessness until even recalling, anticipating, and thinking dissolve like snowflakes into a warm ocean. Reach for it when you feel solid and separate and want to dissolve the sense of a bounded self watching experience from the inside.

title: 606m ⭐️ talopa ganges
name: Tilopa's Ganges Mahamudra
summary: Three clearing breaths with light visualization, a field-of-support invocation with Tilopa and the masters dissolving into light at the heart, a search for the self that finds only unbound awareness, then opening the eyes to recognize sights, sounds, and thoughts as one seamless field, sealed with increasing immediacy until even the sealing rests as effortless. Reach for it when you want the full arc from settling the body to resting in non-dual awareness, and have time for a longer, guided descent into Mahamudra.

title: 608m orienting, lion's gaze (+14m)
name: Lion's gaze
summary: Establishes the effortless natural state, then teaches Maitrepa's lion's gaze through two instructions—do not particularize, and mindfulness without a looker—so that instead of chasing each arising event like a dog after a stick, you orient like a lion back toward the source, seeing through appearances to the ground itself. Reach for it when you keep getting pulled into the contents of experience and want to rest in what's aware of them instead.

title: 611m ⭐️ radiance
name: The key of radiance
summary: Three clearing breaths and blessings from an assembled field of teachers seed a felt sense of trust in your heart, then attention rests in the wide-open field of hearing to find awareness that is edgeless and changeless, before opening the eyes and treating every sight, sound, and thought as one taste of awareness expressing itself to itself, sealed by immediate recognition. Reach for it when you want to move from settled stillness into open-eyed daily life without losing the boundless view.

title: Med： boundless awareness (Thu 7) [c73abfbcb6e94335b34e9837ac839d1c]
name: Boundless awareness
summary: Opens with clearing breaths and a blessing visualization for trust, then grounds awareness in the base of the body and expands it outward in stages—lower body, midsection, upper body, skin—before releasing it in all six directions (down, front, back, up, right, left) "miles and miles" until it becomes one edgeless field in which events arise and pass while the awareness itself stays timeless and changeless. Reach for it when your practice feels too small or bounded and you need a body-based gateway into vast, boundless awareness.

title: Med： emptiness - all phenomena (Thu 1) [afe87c17a07344989e81780461970594]
name: Emptiness of all phenomena
summary: Opens the ears into a wide 360-degree field, then adds sight, body sensations, and finally smells and tastes into that same open awareness, holding the view that all of it is appearance emptiness, arising but insubstantial, then takes this view off the cushion into five silent minutes of walking. Reach for it when everything still feels split into "me in here" and "the world out there" and you need a body-based way to dissolve that boundary.

title: Med： emptiness - awareness (Wed 3) [5fdf96d1aa1b4f8b907e6fee54e691d0]
name: Emptiness - awareness
summary: After a brief pre-meditation routine, calls forth the ordinary sense of self, searches for it through the body and then through mental content, and finally searches for the searcher itself, arriving at awareness that has no size, shape, color, or form yet remains vividly knowing. Reach for it when you keep finding a subtle meditator or watcher still standing behind your practice and want to see through it to the awareness that has no location at all.

title: Med： emptiness - body (Wed 5) [7c37f990b0c54a6fb6ce7e404f8cc884]
name: Emptiness - body
summary: Opens with clearing breaths, bodhicitta, and a lineage blessing dissolving into the heart, then grounds attention in the seat and body before systematically dissolving the body's edges in each direction—down, forward, up, back, right, left—until sensation is felt as one open field rather than discrete, solid parts. Reach for it when you feel armored in your body and need sensation itself to feel less solid and gripping.

title: Med： emptiness - negative emotions (Thu 3) [cacffd7b38a04c2fac3d7ea395a4bb73]
name: Emptiness of a negative emotion
summary: Guides you to pick a familiar low-intensity negative emotion, locate its somatic sensation in the body, search for both the emotion and the self feeling it until neither can be found, then hold the raw sensation in that open awareness so it can mature into its highest expression, like anger into clarity or shame into aspiration. Reach for it when a recurring negative emotion has grip on you and you want to loosen its reactivity without suppressing or getting rid of it.

title: Med： emptiness - self representation (Wed 1) [d8361a01ac3d43b5a8afe9e50169533e]
name: Who you take yourself to be
summary: After nine-round breathing and a blessing visualization, the practice calls forth your current self-representation of traits and preferences, then compares it to your seven-or-eight-year-old self and a future spiritually matured self to reveal the self as impermanent and construction-like, then rests attention in the unchanging awareness underneath all three versions. Reach for it when you feel fused with a fixed idea of who you are and need to loosen that grip by seeing yourself as ever-changing.

title: Med： emptiness - self (Wed 2) [ed4f499c15674adbb96a4752430532ee]
name: Emptiness - self
summary: After a brief posture and heart-connection setup, this practice calls forth the felt sense of self and systematically searches for it outside the body, inside the body part by part, in thoughts, and in emotions, arriving each time at unfindability before resting in the bare knowing awareness that remains. Reach for it when your sense of self feels heavy, solid, or overly identified with the day ahead and you need to loosen that grip before diving in.

title: Med： emptiness - sound (Wed 4) [199ea6c82c674481b50e8f5d2db69697]
name: Emptiness - sound
summary: Opens with clearing breaths and a brief field-of-support visualization, then guides you to notice hearing as a naturally 360-degree field, reframes sounds as arising within that field rather than "out there," and lets them turn insubstantial and non-elaborated, like echoes, until sound stops pulling you out of awareness. Reach for it when your mind keeps snagging on noises and sounds outside feel like intrusions you have to fight off.

title: Med： emptiness - thought (Thu 2) [8fe3015ea3574971819793503b2f8726]
name: Emptiness - thought
summary: This session opens with three clearing breaths and an intention-setting, then guides three investigations of thought itself, not its content: whether it has a location, how it comes, stays, and passes, and whether it has any size, shape, or color, before closing with a visualization of masters dissolving into light above the head. Reach for it when thoughts feel sticky and convincing and you want to loosen their grip without trying to stop them.

title: Med： emptiness - vision (Wed 6) [a9b88d7974ab4d55bb69f2a9ba17d723]
name: The eyes as the doorway
summary: A Dzogchen sky-gazing practice done eyes-open: after the preliminaries, you pour inner awareness out through the eyes into the space ahead, pour the space back in, mix the two into one field, check for edges and open into any that appear, then hold the view that all visual forms arise within that field rather than "out there," letting color and shape stay vivid while losing their solidity, grab, and judgment. Reach for it when you are meditating with eyes closed out of habit and need a way to bring that same open, unhooked awareness into ordinary seeing.

title: Med： non meditation - 6 nails (Sat 3) [f33195f304f54af7a177f38a90a890d9]
name: Tilopa's six nails
summary: Nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing to settle in, a guru-field visualization dissolving into light at the heart, then a progressive opening into wide, boundless awareness across sound and sight, followed by sealing every arising thought, sensation, hope, and fear as the same taste of emptiness until recognition becomes effortless. Reach for it when you are already familiar with resting in awareness and want to push past subtle grasping into non-meditation itself.

title: Med： non meditation - radiance (Sat 12) [a5c13631efa742d091c57c561f43bc1f]
name: The whole arc into radiance
summary: Nine rounds of balancing breath, a lineage refuge and blessing visualization, then mindfulness tied to the body as a whole, sharpened first to the boundary of contact, then to the breathing body's first instants of expansion and release, with ongoing checks for dullness and agitation. Reach for it when you have real energy and time for a full session and want to build steady concentration from the ground up before moving into subtler stages.

title: Med： non meditation - recognizing via centerlessness (Sat 8) [ce5a34ba80094a5dac5005d8f59b70ae]
name: Recognizing via centerlessness
summary: Sets a Sabari-lineage foundation of blessings and trust, opens awareness into a boundless field where all sense-events are recognized as one taste, then repeatedly locates any felt center or source and opens directly into it until awareness is confirmed as centerless, non-local, and everywhere at once. Reach for it when you feel identified with a particular vantage point or self-location and need to loosen the sense of awareness coming from somewhere in particular.

title: Med： non meditation - recognizing via knowing (Sat 6) [ff11659344954f6bb3e869f47c1471bf]
name: Non meditation - recognizing via knowing
summary: Three clearing breaths and a lineage-blessing visualization settle into an open field of hearing, then the practice seals awareness with immediacy, range, and finally the recognition that events are known prior to arising, until sealing itself dissolves into the effortless resting of non-meditation. Reach for it when you are ready to move past technique altogether and just recognize the awareness that was already knowing everything before you tried to notice it.

title: Med： one taste - all phenomena (Fri 7) [23b1dcb7b17c4272a8bd526e0b235d0a]
name: One taste of everything
summary: Three clearing breaths, an invited assembly of masters dissolved into a sphere of light at the heart, then a systematic opening through hearing, sight, sensation, and finally thoughts and emotions, each checked for boundaries and recognized as one taste within a single open awareness. Reach for it when you feel fragmented across senses and thoughts and want everything to click into one seamless field.

title: Med： one taste - non duality (Fri 10) [7a4c480f4d894b77a37566335cfd5f5d]
name: Establishing non-duality
summary: Nine rounds of breath and a blessing-light visualization settle the mind, then attention opens through hearing, seeing, and all sensory events to rest as a single boundless field of awareness in which everything, including the self, arises as one taste, like breezes in an open sky. Reach for it when you feel fragmented by inner and outer distinctions and want to dissolve the sense of separation between yourself and experience.

title: Med： one taste - sealing (Fri 12) [fc22755f57f14a9695ebe4fd275b9e00]
name: One taste - sealing
summary: Nine-breath purification and a field-of-support blessing open into resting as wide-open, edgeless awareness through the sense of hearing, then eyes open to affirm every arising thought, sensation, and sound as that same awareness the instant it appears, both immediately and down into background hopes, fears, and assumptions, until recognition turns effortless. Reach for it when your meditation still feels like effortful doing and you are ready to let noticing itself become soft, immediate, and complete.

title: Med： one taste - sound (Fri 2) [8a6239a50ebb45e0a9edc1fbb1c84951]
name: One taste of sound
summary: This guided sit opens with clearing breaths and a blessing-light visualization, then settles into the field of hearing, checks it for edges until it opens into a boundless, timeless awareness, and finally reframes every sound as a wave rising and dissolving back into that same ocean of awareness so hearing itself becomes awareness knowing itself. Reach for it when sounds keep pulling you outward as distractions and you want to hear them instead as the same substance as the mind that hears them.

title: Med： one taste - visual forms (Fri 4) [b70b5e9653d04964b8c99ead36b4aed2]
name: One taste of visual forms
summary: Guided preparation with clearing breaths and a masters-light visualization opens into eyes-open practice, pouring awareness through the eyes into the space ahead until awareness and space merge into one field, then checking for edges and dissolving them, before viewing all visual forms as reflections in a mirror or crystal sphere, inseparable from the awareness in which they appear. Reach for it when your eyes feel like they're pulling you out into a separate, solid world and you need to recognize what you see as not other than the mind that sees it.

title: Med： timeless awareness (Thu 6) [4e077eff521c4c9e8b2ed741e69bf730]
name: Timeless awareness
summary: A brief stretch break and refuge visualization lead into resting as the field of hearing, checking for edges until none are found, then noticing that sounds arise and pass while the boundless awareness holding them does not. Reach for it when you want to feel the difference between what changes and what doesn't, and need a felt sense of spaciousness rather than an idea of it.

title: Med： timelessness of breath (Thu 5) [ae1454e9d737408ca170ef352578d624]
name: Timelessness through the breath
summary: This session opens with clearing breaths, an intention-setting, and a retinue-of-masters blessing before settling into the breath itself, then offers two ways to find the timeless awareness behind it—first noticing the same awareness present through both inhale and exhale, then applying Nagarjuna's instructions that breath never truly arises or passes but is already here. Reach for it when you keep noticing the breath change and want to find the part of you that doesn't change with it.

title: 04. Starting a Sit
name: 04. Starting a Sit
summary: Guides you through a three-breaths-and-smile check-in, then a full-body postural alignment from hips to jaw, then a progressive breath-awareness sweep from belly to skull, repeating the same three-breaths-and-smile check-in after each stage to notice how it shifts. Reach for it when you are starting your very first sit or need a repeatable way to settle into any sit without having to figure out what to do.

title: 05. Ways of smiling
name: 05. Ways of smiling
summary: A guided sequence of smiling at decreasing then rebuilding levels of effort, moving from full effort to half, quarter, and minimal effort, then relocating the smile to the heart, the eyes, all three together, and finally the whole body, before ending with a slow build from the softest smile back up to a full grin. Reach for it when you feel flat or emotionally muted and want to experiment your way back into warmth rather than force a mood.

title: 06. Gratitude - Guided sit
name: 06. Gratitude - Guided sit
summary: A brief check for an available smile, followed by a layered gratitude scan through physical conditions, life circumstances, other people, and your own journey, then a return to the smile to notice how it has shifted. Reach for it when positive emotion feels unreachable or forced and you need a way in besides sheer effort.

title: 07. Love - Guided sit
name: Three people who loved you
summary: A short breath practice with longer exhales settles the body, then you call to mind three people who have shown you love in turn, dwelling on memories and their felt presence before blending all three together and silently repeating "I am loved," then closing by extending that same love outward to someone else. Reach for it when you feel disconnected or unloved and need to remember you are cared for.

title: 08. Guided Metta Mantras
name: 08. Guided Metta Mantras
summary: A settling body scan and receptive listening lead into a series of loving-kindness phrases, each tested against whatever smile feels authentic, then the same phrases and feeling are extended to a loved one so care flows both ways. Reach for it when you feel flat or closed off and want to warm up toward yourself and others before the day gets going.

title: 09. Tensing relaxing
name: 09. Tensing relaxing
summary: A guided progressive tense-and-release moving through hands, feet, abdomen, chest and upper back, head, and finally the whole body, each round shrinking from full physical tensing to imperceptible, intention-only tensing and releasing. Reach for it when you don't yet know what relaxing actually feels like and need your body to teach you before your mind can find it.

title: 10. Smiling and relaxing with the breath
name: 10. Smiling and relaxing with the breath
summary: Pairs breath with relaxation and smiling in shifting combinations, first relaxing on the exhale and smiling on the inhale, then reversing the pattern, before letting both intentions dissolve into open awareness. Reach for it when you feel flat or joyless and need to coax warmth back into the body without forcing it.

title: 11. Receptivity, working with what's here
name: 11. Receptivity, working with what's here
summary: Opens with roughly twenty minutes of receptive listening and bodily sensing to relax the system, then shifts into gently asking two alternating questions—what feels at ease, and what can be enjoyed—before closing with ten minutes of silent, self-directed practice. Reach for it when you feel keyed up or flat and need a structured way to nudge yourself toward ease or enjoyment without forcing it.

title: 13. Ways of being curious
name: Curiosity by quality
summary: A sequential body-scan-like inquiry that guides attention through emotional tone, energy, temperature, weight, density, shape, texture, color, flavor, and finally melody, applying sensory qualities to experience itself rather than to any object. Reach for it when your mind feels flat or abstract and you need a playful way to re-sensitize yourself to the present moment.

title: 14. All 3 pillars
name: 14. All 3 pillars
summary: Grounds the body through gravity and settling like a snow globe, then layers in curiosity by asking what is here, adds relaxation into any agitation, folds in enjoyment of the resting curiosity itself, and finally lets all three qualities blend and support each other freely. Reach for it when you have practiced these elements separately and are ready to let them merge into one seamless, self-sustaining flow.

title: 16. Sensitivity with mantras
name: 16. Sensitivity with mantras
summary: Cycles through four loving-kindness phrases (safe, in love, at ease, happy), then compresses them to single words, then drops the words entirely to evoke each feeling directly, letting the distinctions between them soften and blend. Reach for it when you want to feel something rather than think about it, and words are getting in the way of actual feeling.

title: 17. Sensitivity with Breathing
name: 17. Sensitivity with Breathing
summary: Settles the body and mind with a general awareness of the breath, then narrows focus to the nostrils, and finally sharpens attention to finer and finer detail of the sensations there, pausing periodically to notice how this deepening subtlety shifts your emotional tone and sense of intimacy with experience. Reach for it when your attention feels dull or coarse and you want to sharpen it through progressively finer noticing.

title: 18. Sensitivity with observing
name: 18. Sensitivity with observing
summary: Settles the body first, then repeatedly asks what you're feeling, followed by how you're relating to that emotion, and finally how you're relating to that relating, peeling back one layer of reaction at a time. Reach for it when your emotions feel tangled or reactive and you sense there's more going on underneath than a single label can capture.

title: 19. Levels of ease
name: Five levels of letting go
summary: Whole-body awareness held steady while the intention shifts through five progressively subtler layers: relax, release, allow, watch, and rest, before letting the body sense dissolve entirely. Reach for it when you keep striving for calm and need a gentler way in than forcing relaxation.

title: 20. Body scan + mantras
name: 20. Body scan + mantras
summary: This session opens with slowing breath and a countdown from 10 to 1 that relaxes the body region by region from face to toes, then shifts into a happy-place visualization before radiating loving-kindness phrases outward from a friend to acquaintances to all beings, closing with a dissolve into open, objectless awareness. Reach for it when you want a long, layered wind-down that moves from physical tension into the heart and finally into spacious stillness.

title: 21. Person you love and radiating sun
name: 21. Person you love and radiating sun
summary: Grounds you into your seat and introduces a "yes, and" phrase to meet curiosity toward whatever arises, then brings a loved one to mind and visualizes your care for them as a sunrise rising from stomach to chest to head, spreading outward until it settles as pure white light at the crown. Reach for it when you want to open the day by generating warmth toward someone you love and softening into openness about what's ahead.

title: 22. Sinking into Enjoyment
name: 22. Sinking into Enjoyment
summary: Repeated prompts to notice something enjoyable, then sinking into it forward, into its center, backward, and straight down, each time going as deep as feels natural before resting in ease. Reach for it when pleasant experience feels thin or fleeting and you need a way to stay with it rather than let it slip past.

title: 23. Leaking Enjoyment
name: 23. Leaking Enjoyment
summary: A soft smile is cultivated in the face, heart, and core, then let leak outward into the surrounding space, then reversed to be absorbed inward from the space, and finally held as a two-way flow leaking out and being absorbed at once. Reach for it when enjoyment feels fragile or short-lived and you want to practice sustaining it through exchange with your surroundings rather than gripping it as a fixed feeling.

title: 24. One Process
name: 24. One Process
summary: This meditation weaves smiling, easing, and curious observation into a single continuous cycle, gently shifting between whichever of the three the moment calls for rather than treating them as separate steps. Reach for it when your practice feels fragmented or forced and you need the pieces of meditation to feel like one seamless motion instead of a checklist.

title: 25. Forgiveness, Gratitude, Relaxation & Enjoyment
name: Forgiveness into gratitude
summary: Guided phrases of self-forgiveness and forgiveness of a situation lead into forward-looking gratitude, then alternating breath cycles pair relaxation on the out-breath with enjoyment on the in-breath, slowing until ease and delight blend into one sustained feeling before a silent stretch and closing bell. Reach for it when you are carrying guilt or tension and need to soften into gratitude and genuine lightness.

title: 26. Radiating in all directions
name: 26. Radiating in all directions
summary: Careful posture setup followed by cultivating a soft smile and a felt sense of love in the heart, then radiating that feeling continuously to the left, right, behind, in front, below, above, and finally in all directions at once. Reach for it when you feel emotionally flat or disconnected and want to actively generate and share warmth rather than just observe your experience.

title: C(St.5) + One Taste(Russia23) - 30min (PBH.Within)
name: Stage 5 concentration into one taste
summary: This session moves through clearing breaths, aspiration and blessings from an assembled field of masters, then dissolves the sense of self and the meditator through direct searching, before settling the mind in five stages from the base of the body to the whole body to its subtle energetic edges, and finally opens into boundless sky-like awareness where all sound, sensation, and thought are received as passing weather. Reach for it when you want a full arc from ordinary identity into open awareness and have thirty unhurried minutes to let it build stage by stage.

title: Concentration 7 & 8
name: Elephant path, stages 7-8: one-pointedness
summary: Three-breath cleansing exhale, a blessing-light visualization from an assembled host of masters dissolving into the heart, then whole-body breath awareness steadied and progressively loosened through the stages of taming, effortlessness, and fine-tuned dialing until the body settles into crisp, vivid one-pointedness. Reach for it when you have already built some stability in sitting and are ready to push concentration to its final, most refined stage.

title: Concentration 9 - EoS ~ 30min(Jan24)
name: The full elephant path, stages 1-9
summary: This session moves through posture and clearing breaths, sets intention and calls in a field of lineage support that dissolves into light at the heart, searches for a findable self in the head and body and then in thoughts and emotions until only open awareness remains, then settles the mind on the base of the body, opens the aperture to the whole body as one field of feeling, and rests there as the breathing body through settling, continuous settling, and resettling. Reach for it when the mind is scattered on waking and you need a full arc from grounding in the body to resting in awareness itself.

title: Emptiness of mind-meditator self - 15min(Stages23)
name: Emptiness of the meditator
summary: Opens with clearing breaths and a guru-blending visualization to settle the mind, then hunts for the meditator's location until it dissolves, then hunts for the searcher itself until the mind too is found unfindable, resting finally in empty, self-knowing awareness. Reach for it when your sense of self as "the one meditating" feels solid and heavy and you need it to dissolve rather than just relax.

title: Emptiness of self - Searching the Aggregates - 15min(Russia23)
name: Searching the aggregates
summary: Three clearing breaths and a blessing visualization settle the body and mind before systematically searching for a self outside the body, inside the body, in thoughts, and in emotions until it proves unfindable, resting finally in the open knowing awareness that remains. Reach for it when you feel solidly identified with a fixed sense of "me" and want direct experience of its emptiness rather than just an idea about it.

title: Emptiness of Thought - 20min(Stages23)
name: Where is a thought?
summary: Begins with a clearing breath, intention-setting, and a guru-assembly blessing that dissolves into the heart, then a brief self-inquiry before three analyses of thought itself: where it is located, how it comes, stays, and goes, and whether it has size, shape, or color. Reach for it when thoughts feel solid and heavy and you need to see through them rather than just watch them pass.

title: EoS+Concentration(St.5) - 20min(Weggis23)
name: Emptiness of self into stage 5
summary: This session moves through the seven-point posture check, three clearing breaths, calling in masters and dissolving them into a sphere of light at the heart, searching for the self and affirming awareness as what remains, then anchors attention at the base of the body and progressively widens the field of feeling through legs, core, and whole body while balancing dullness and agitation with the white and black lotus, ending in a search for the body's edges until it dissolves into vibrancy. Reach for it when you have time for a full formal sit and want to move from settling and self-inquiry into a stable, energized, boundary-dissolving awareness of the whole body.

title: Gate of Body - 20min(Ru23)
name: The body as the doorway
summary: Nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing, an invitation and dissolution of a lineage of masters into a sphere of light at the heart, then body awareness built up from the base through the whole body, expanded past the skin's edge, opened directionally in ten directions until it becomes a wide-open field in which the body itself arises as insubstantial. Reach for it when you feel dense, contracted, or too identified with the solidity of your body and want to loosen that grip before the day begins.

title: Gate of Ears - 10min(Ru23)
name: Sound as the doorway
summary: Opens with a lineage-blessing visualization to settle intent, then shifts attention to the naturally wide-open field of hearing, reframing sounds as arising within awareness rather than out there, so they grow insubstantial, unlabeled, and less able to hook you. Reach for it when you feel jumpy or reactive to noise and need sounds to stop pulling you out of yourself.

title: M4. Slashing & Increasing Thoughts - 10min(Ru23)
name: Slashing and increasing thoughts
summary: Rests attention in the open field of hearing like a wide-open sky, then slashes each thought with the sword of awareness the instant it stirs, before flipping the exercise to deliberately spark one thought after another until thinking wears itself out into clear, open knowing. Reach for it when the mind is scattered and grabby in the morning and you need to catch it in the act rather than follow it into the day.

title: M7. Taming(St.5) - 20min(Ru23)
name: Elephant path, stage 5: taming the mind
summary: Nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing, then an invocation of lineage masters dissolving into light and absorbing into the heart, then whole-body awareness balanced with a white sphere for dullness or a black sphere for agitation, then a close inquiry into the body's edges until it dissolves into a field of vibration. Reach for it when your mind is scattered across many small distractions and needs a long, structured descent into stillness before the day begins.

title: M8. Pacifying(St.6) - 20min(Ru23)
name: Elephant path, stage 6: pacifying
summary: This meditation moves through nine rounds of alternate-nostril breathing, a devotional visualization of masters dissolving into light and settling into the heart, then whole-body awareness that progresses from tracking sensations part-by-part to sensing the body as one field, dissolving its edges, and finally loosening the grip of effort until the practice sustains itself. Reach for it when your mind is scattered and effortful first thing in the morning and you need a structured on-ramp from busyness into calm, spacious presence.

title: M9. Completely Pacifying(St.7) - 20min(Ru23)
name: Elephant path, stage 7: complete pacification
summary: Three cleansing breaths with a hissing exhale, then invoking masters for blessings that dissolve into light and settle into the heart, followed by resting as whole-body awareness through progressive stages of curiosity, dissolving boundaries, and loosening into effortless, pacified concentration. Reach for it when you want to move from devotional trust into subtle, self-sustaining stillness rather than force focus through effort.

title: Meditation 6 ~ Complete Settling (Stage 4)
name: Elephant path, stage 4: complete settling
summary: This session guides clearing breaths, sets intention, dissolves an assembly of masters into a sphere of light absorbed into the heart, then settles attention from the base of the body outward into whole-body awareness of the breath, before teaching corrections for dullness (eyes wide, or a bright sphere shot skyward) and agitation (eyes closed, or a dark sphere grounded downward). Reach for it when you feel scattered between fogginess and restlessness and want a full posture-to-close practice that also trains you to recognize and correct your own energy level.

title: Negative Emotions - 10min(Stages23)
name: Meeting a difficult emotion
summary: Three clearing breaths and a guru-blessing visualization open into a brief emptiness-of-self search, then a chosen negative emotion is evoked and probed for location and findability in the body, the searching self is likewise hunted and found unfindable, and the residual sensations are held in that open awareness until they resolve into their clarified energetic potential. Reach for it when a familiar negative emotion has hooked you and you want its energy back without the story it drags along.

title: Positive Emotions - 10min(Stages23)
name: Emptiness of a positive emotion
summary: Guru yoga to dissolve the meditator into blessing-light, then evoke a strong positive emotion and search the body for the feeling itself, the self who feels it, and finally rest in open awareness where the same emotion returns liberated as unconditional love or universal compassion. Reach for it when your positive feelings seem fragile or conditional and you want them grounded in something more spacious and unshakeable.

title: Timeless Awareness(Breath) - 10min(Ru23)
name: Timeless awareness, breath and sound
summary: Opens with guru yoga (setting intention, inviting masters, dissolving light into the heart), then uses the breath to find the awareness that knows both inhale and exhale without itself coming and going, and closes by extending that same recognition to the open field of hearing in which all sounds arise and pass. Reach for it when your mind is fixated on time and change and you need to drop into what stays still beneath both.

title: Timeless-Boundless Awareness(Sound) - 10min(Weggis23)
name: Timeless and boundless through sound
summary: Opens with a clearing breath and blessing visualization, then a quick search for the self that dissolves into bare awareness, before settling attention into the open field of hearing and pushing outward to find its edges until none remain, resting finally in timeless, boundless awareness that holds all sounds without moving. Reach for it when you feel hemmed in or contracted and need your morning to open into something vast rather than narrow.

title: Tonglen(with Music) - 25min (pbh.PlanetEarth)
name: Tonglen, breathing in what is hard
summary: Three clearing breaths and a rest into open awareness open the session, followed by an invocation of masters dissolved into a heart-light, then a diamond in the chest is used to breathe in suffering as dark smoke and exhale it back as healing light for yourself, a loved one, a neutral person, a difficult person, and finally all forgotten beings. Reach for it when your heart feels closed or self-focused and you need to widen your circle of care before the day begins.
